headline: Sunday in Branson: Crisp Skies & Holiday Cheer
lede: Sunday, November 15 brings mostly sunny skies with a high near 55°F and a low around 31°F — perfect crisp weather for first-timers to enjoy the lakes, shows, and growing holiday lights across the Landing and Strip.

featured.title: Holiday Lights on the Landing
featured.why: The fountain and waterfront are dressed in festive lights. A magical, low-key evening walk with views of Table Rock Lake — ideal for families and first-time visitors.

plan.title: Coffee & Lake View
plan.detail: Start with sunrise over Table Rock from the Notch or Indian Point. Grab coffee at a nearby cafe and watch the light hit the water.

plan.title: Matinee Show or Landing Stroll
plan.detail: Catch one of the many afternoon Christmas or variety shows, or walk the Branson Landing promenade and fountain.

plan.title: Holiday Lights Drive
plan.detail: Drive the Strip or return to the Landing as the lights come on. Mild evening temps make it comfortable for photos and exploration.

indoor.name: Sight & Sound Theatres
indoor.detail: Miracle of Christmas production with spectacular sets and live animals. A first-timer favorite.

indoor.name: Clay Cooper Theatre
indoor.detail: High-energy Christmas and country shows in a comfortable theater.

indoor.name: Americana Theatre
indoor.detail: Holiday variety, gospel, and magic shows throughout the day.
